hobby.detalle: la Pasita, aspirante a idol de K-pop

arte.universo: The world of K-pop idols, original: a tiny bedroom home studio at night (posters, keyboard, mic, laptop, fairy lights) and a huge futuristic entertainment agency tower in Seoul-like city at night with neon signs, glass floors, rehearsal rooms with mirrors, recording booths, a merch workshop, a shipping area, a power generator room and a central executive office with a secure glowing vault. The Pasita is an idol trainee: stylish oversized jacket, small headset mic, sneakers. Lightsticks and stage lights in cyan and magenta. Use only the PASAS emblem (raisin silhouette in a circle) on any logo, banner or lightstick.

post:
¿Procariota o eucariota? Piénsalo como en el mundo idol: un estudio indie donde todo pasa en un solo cuarto vs. una mega agencia con departamentos y una bóveda. 🎤🧬

Así se explica en PASAS: cada tema con lo que te gusta (K-pop, anime, videojuegos o fútbol).

La última lámina es tu acordeón: guárdalo para tu examen de biología.

#biologia #celula #secundaria #kpop #pasasmx

escena.accion: The Pasita idol trainee strikes a confident debut pose on a stage while a giant hologram behind her shows two shapes side by side: a simple capsule-shaped cell with loose tangled strands and a complex round cell full of compartments and a glowing central nucleus
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, large, center-lower frame, headset mic, winking, one hand forming a heart
escena.objeto: The two holographic cells (simple vs compartmented) glowing in cyan and magenta
escena.foreground: Raised lightsticks of the crowd with the PASAS raisin emblem, blurred
escena.background: The hologram cells and stage light beams
escena.iluminacion: Cyan and magenta stage lights, haze, sparkles
escena.composicion: Low-angle concert shot, character big in the lower 55%

slides.texto: La Pasita empieza sola en su cuarto: ahí **compone, graba, ensaya y edita**, todo en el mismo espacio. Sus canciones están regadas por todas partes, **sin un lugar protegido**.

escena.accion: The Pasita multitasks in a tiny cluttered bedroom studio: singing into a mic while editing on a laptop and practicing a dance step at the same time
escena.protagonista: The Pasita on the right half, medium shot, busy and determined
escena.objeto: One single small room with no walls or divisions where everything happens together; loose sheets of song lyrics (blank pages, no writing) scattered everywhere on the floor and desk
escena.foreground: Scattered blank music sheets and cables
escena.midground: The Pasita, desk with keyboard and laptop
escena.background: Posters with abstract shapes, fairy lights, small window with night city
escena.iluminacion: Warm desk lamp and colorful fairy lights
escena.composicion: Medium shot, cozy cramped room, subject on the right half

slides.texto: Luego la ficha una mega agencia: un edificio con **departamentos separados por paredes** (grabación, coreografía, merch) y una **oficina central con bóveda** donde guardan los planes del comeback.

escena.accion: The Pasita stands amazed at the entrance of a gigantic agency tower shown as a cutaway: each floor is a separate room with walls (recording booth, mirror dance studio, merch workshop, generator room) and in the center a glowing executive office with a secure vault
escena.protagonista: The Pasita at the bottom right, looking up in awe, holding a contract
escena.objeto: The cutaway agency tower with clearly separated compartments and a central glowing vault
escena.midground: The Pasita and the building base
escena.iluminacion: Each floor lit with a different color, the vault glowing gold
escena.composicion: Giant object dominating the right 2/3, strong vertical perspective

slides.problema: En la agencia, cada tarea tiene **su propio cuarto**:
pasos: Los planes del comeback → la **bóveda** de la oficina central
La energía para los ensayos → el **cuarto de generadores**
Empacar y enviar → el **área de envíos**

escena.accion: The Pasita walks along a glass hallway peeking into separate rooms: a humming generator room with glowing batteries, a merch workshop, a packing area with boxes
escena.protagonista: The Pasita at the bottom center, walking, pointing at the rooms, curious
escena.objeto: A row of separate glass-walled departments, each clearly doing one job
escena.foreground: Cardboard boxes with the PASAS emblem
escena.midground: The hallway and the Pasita in the bottom 30%
escena.iluminacion: Cool office lights with a warm glow from the generator room
escena.composicion: Wide hallway shot, all detail in the bottom 30%

slides.texto: Las dos hacen música. Pero una lo hace **todo en un cuarto**, con las canciones sueltas, y la otra tiene **departamentos con paredes** y una **bóveda** que protege lo más importante.

escena.accion: Split composition: on the left the tiny one-room studio with loose papers floating freely; on the right the compartmented agency with the central vault glowing; the Pasita stands in the middle pointing to both
escena.protagonista: The Pasita in the middle, medium-large, arms open pointing to each side, thoughtful smile
escena.objeto: The side-by-side comparison: one undivided room with loose papers vs a building with walls, rooms and a protected vault
escena.foreground: A dividing glowing line on the floor
escena.iluminacion: Warm on the left side, cool neon on the right side
escena.composicion: Symmetrical split screen, character centered in the lower half

pares: El estudio de un solo cuarto

escena.accion: The Pasita has a eureka moment: the agency tower transforms into a giant round eukaryotic cell with organelles while the bedroom studio transforms into a small capsule-shaped bacterial cell
escena.protagonista: The Pasita at the bottom right, pointing up, amazed, sparkles around her
escena.objeto: The transformation: building → cell with nucleus and organelles; room → simple cell with loose DNA strands
escena.background: The two cells glowing softly behind
escena.iluminacion: Golden eureka glow plus cyan neon
escena.composicion: Medium-close character at bottom right, calm area above

slides.nota: La procariota **no tiene núcleo**: su ADN anda suelto en el citoplasma.

escena.accion: The Pasita holds up two lightsticks: one shaped like a simple capsule cell, one shaped like a complex cell with a nucleus, comparing them
escena.protagonista: The Pasita on the right half, medium shot, explaining with confidence
escena.objeto: The two lightsticks as cell models (simple vs with glowing nucleus)
escena.background: Mirror dance studio with neon strip lights
escena.iluminacion: Cyan neon strips and soft magenta reflections
escena.composicion: Character on the right, calm left side

slides.pregunta: La Pasita encuentra una célula con su **ADN suelto**, sin bóveda que lo proteja. ¿Qué tipo de célula es?

escena.accion: The Pasita examines a floating holographic cell through a big magnifying glass: the cell is a simple capsule with loose tangled DNA strands and no nucleus
escena.protagonista: The Pasita on the right, leaning in with a magnifying glass, curious
escena.objeto: The holographic simple cell with loose DNA, clearly without a nucleus
escena.midground: The Pasita and the hologram on the right half
escena.background: Dark lab-like backstage with neon lines
escena.iluminacion: Cyan hologram light on her face
escena.composicion: Medium shot, subject on the right half

pasos.t: **Ambas** tienen membrana, citoplasma, ADN y ribosomas.
**Procariota**: sin núcleo, el ADN anda suelto.

slides.recuerdo: Estudio indie = todo en **un cuarto** (procariota). Mega agencia = **departamentos y bóveda** (eucariota).
slides.respuesta_reto: Procariota (su ADN está suelto, sin núcleo)
